notes: Original Write Essay prompts. Key points list ideas a strong answer is likely to discuss. Prompts 31 to 45 are backup questions.

payload.prompt: Some people believe that governments should make public transport free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many universities now offer entire degrees online. Do the advantages of online degrees outweigh the disadvantages? Support your answer with reasons and examples.
key_points: less interaction with teachers and classmates

payload.prompt: Some people think children should start learning a foreign language at primary school, while others believe it is better to begin at secondary school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Artificial intelligence is changing the way people work. Will it create more jobs than it replaces? Discuss with reference to specific industries.
key_points: specific industries such as healthcare or manufacturing

payload.prompt: In many cities, people spend long hours commuting to work. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
key_points: better public transport and housing near work

payload.prompt: Some people argue that university education should be free for all students. Others think students should pay because they benefit personally. Discuss both sides and give your view.
Tourism brings economic benefits to many countries, but it can also damage the environment and local communities. How can governments balance these effects?
Social media has changed the way people communicate. Has it had a mainly positive or negative effect on relationships? Give reasons for your answer.
Some people believe that exams are the best way to assess students, while others prefer continuous assessment such as projects and assignments. Which do you think is more effective?
Climate change is a global problem, so some people argue that individual actions make little difference. To what extent do you agree?
More and more people are choosing to work from home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend for employees and employers?
Some people think that sport and physical education should be compulsory in every school year. Others believe students should be free to choose. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Many countries face housing shortages in their largest cities. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could governments take?
Some people believe that famous athletes and entertainers are paid too much compared with doctors and teachers. Do you agree or disagree?
key_points: value of doctors and teachers to society

payload.prompt: Supermarkets should be required to donate unsold food rather than throw it away. Discuss the benefits and challenges of such a law.
Some argue that space exploration is a waste of money when there are serious problems on Earth. Others believe it brings important benefits. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
key_points: problems such as poverty and climate change

payload.prompt: In some countries, young people are encouraged to take a gap year between school and university. What are the advantages and disadvantages of taking a gap year?
Advertising aimed at children should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Some people believe that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others think there are better ways. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
key_points: causes of crime such as poverty

payload.prompt: Museums and art galleries should be free for the public. Do you agree or disagree? Support your opinion with reasons and examples.
Many people now read news online rather than in newspapers. How has this change affected the quality of information people receive?
Some people think that developed countries should do more to help developing countries, while others believe each country should solve its own problems. Discuss both views.
Plastic bags and single-use plastics should be completely banned. Do you agree? Discuss the possible effects of such a ban.
Children today spend a lot of time using digital devices. What effects does this have on their development, and what should parents do?

Some people believe that universities should focus on preparing students for employment. Others think universities should focus on knowledge and critical thinking. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Should governments tax unhealthy foods such as sugary drinks and fast food to improve public health? Give reasons for your answer.
Many older people continue working after retirement age. Is this a positive or negative development for individuals and society?
Some people believe that protecting endangered species is a waste of resources. Others think it is essential. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Group projects are a common part of university courses. Do they help students develop useful skills, or do they cause more problems than benefits?
Some cities have introduced car-free zones in their centres. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this policy?
Some people believe that homework should be banned in primary schools. Do you agree or disagree?
Genetically modified crops could help feed a growing world population, but some people are concerned about their risks. Discuss both sides of this issue.
It is better to have a job you enjoy with a low salary than a well-paid job you dislike. To what extent do you agree?
Some people think learning history is not useful in the modern world. Others believe it is essential. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
As more people move to cities, rural areas are losing population. What problems does this cause, and how can they be addressed?
key_points: loss of services in rural areas

payload.prompt: Should students be required to do community service as part of their education? Give reasons and examples to support your view.
Some people think that fast food restaurants should not be allowed near schools. Do you agree or disagree?
The increasing use of cashless payments may lead to a society without cash. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this change?
Some believe that newspapers and television should not report details of crimes because it encourages fear. Do you agree or disagree?
Should international students be allowed to work while studying? Discuss the benefits and possible problems.
Some people argue that nuclear power is necessary to reduce carbon emissions, while others believe it is too dangerous. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Should zoos be closed? Discuss the arguments for and against keeping animals in zoos.
Many people use online reviews to decide what to buy. How reliable are these reviews, and what effects do they have on businesses?
Some people think governments should spend more on public health campaigns, while others think money should go to hospitals and treatment. Which is more effective?
Learning to cook should be a compulsory subject in schools. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
